Since our method leverages the large model to generate reasoning paths or feedback, it is essential to identify the subset of data where such intervention is useful. If the large model consistently fails to solve a query, calling it during training yields no positive gain. Therefore, we preprocess the dataset to filter out instances that are too hard for the large model. We sample 10 responses per query and only preserve those with a pass rate of ≥ 50 % \geq 50\% . This step ensures that the training data lies in the competence boundary of the large model and the responses can contribute effectively.
